Name: [Formatting] Measures must have a format string
Description: Every measure needs an explicit format string so consumers see consistent numbers.

Name: [Model] Hide foreign key columns
Description: Columns on the many side of a relationship should be hidden.
Expression: UsedInRelationships.Any(FromColumn.Name == current.Name and FromColumn.Table.Name == current.Table.Name) and IsHidden == false

Name: [Performance] Avoid floating point (Double) columns
Description: Use Decimal (fixed) or Int64 to avoid rounding errors in key totals.

Name: [Deployment] Partitions must use the environment parameters
Description: M partitions must reference the CatalogName/SchemaName parameters (no hard-coded catalog or schema), so the pipeline can retarget Dev/QA/Prod.

Name: [Performance] Relationship columns should be Int64
Description: Integer surrogate keys compress and join better than text keys.

Name: [Security] Model should define at least one security role
Description: Production models are expected to define RLS/OLS roles.
